I've looked through the past few days of posts here, and have noticed a surprising lack of E3-related discussion, so I thought I'd get the ball rolling.

As the title states, what bold predictions do you have for E3 this year? That is, predictions that are unlikely, but not completely out of the realm of reality. A few I can think of offhandedly:

Nintendo announces the successor to the 3DS, and the 8th generation of Pokemon is announced to be released on it.

With Sony more or less out of the mobile gaming market, Nintendo's only real competition at this point are smartphones/tablets, which also lean heavily on a more casual audience. While mobile devices have rapidly iterated, Nintendo has remained largely stagnant in terms of hardware. The Nintendo 3DS has been out for over 7 years now, with the New Nintendo 3DS for over 3. In short, this generation of handhelds is already the second-longest generation, if you don't include the Game Boy Pocket or New Nintendo 3DS as separate generations. This is as good a time as any for Nintendo to get a new generation of mobile devices out, and Pokemon is as good a selling point as ever. As an added bonus, Pokemon has not been on the same device for more than 2 mainline title generations, and 6 and 7 have both been 3DS-based. The dream of a proper mainline Pokemon game on a console remains to be realized.

Bethesda doesn't use either Fallout 4 or Skyrim in their presentation

With Skyrim now being on every current-gen console, I have a hard time seeing them further milking the franchise at this point, and working on either spinoffs or, less likely, a proper sequel. As far as Fallout goes, I'd imagine the recently-announced Fallout 76 will be the primary focus of the Fallout franchise. As such, I wouldn't be completely surprised if both games ended up not being mentioned.

A Way Out gets DLC announced

A Way Out is one of the more surprising successes of 2018 so far, allegedly selling over 1 million copies in two weeks. Because it's connected to EA, you just know they're going to milk it dry somehow, at some point. The game more or less wraps up its plot within the base game, so the likeliest route is expanding upon the main plot, adding in extra endings.

I'm sure there are several others, including ones I have that I simply don't remember at the moment, so what bold predictions do you guys have?
